objective: Recover desktop resource controls across control-plane startup gaps, keep long chat content fully reachable, evaluate and only promote a materially better Vietnamese local voice model when quality, provenance and the owner-approved all-on VRAM ceiling pass, and reduce Qwen runtime memory pressure with documented Ollama controls without misrepresenting RAM/VRAM offload.
non_goals: Do not promote a TTS candidate from model-card claims alone, accept an unknown or incompatible weight/data license, delete owner-provided voice samples, or retain benchmark audio and one-off scripts after recording bounded metrics.

Do not replace the current q4_K_M brain weights with q8 weights under the false assumption that q8 is smaller, raise context beyond 8,192, add a second resident brain, bypass the scheduler, or exceed the owner-approved 15,872 MiB physical VRAM ceiling.

Do not make Hina train online from raw chat, public messages or unreviewed model output; this slice documents the future consented offline SFT/LoRA plus preference-learning path but does not open M11.
contracts: A desktop owner action that begins during the bounded control-plane startup or restart window retries only idempotent read/load/unload control calls with a fixed deadline and reports phase plus correlation-safe error after exhaustion; it never loops indefinitely or hides a runtime crash.

The launcher proves control-plane readiness before considering desktop startup healthy, reuses one live loopback runtime, surfaces child exit and startup log output, and does not leak duplicate managed bridge/runtime processes.

The chat message viewport and sticky composer form a bounded flex layout with min-height zero, independent overflow and bottom padding so the final assistant message remains fully reachable at every supported desktop size.

A TTS replacement is selected only after real Vietnamese owner-reference generation, reverse-STT intelligibility, listening handoff, code/weight/data provenance review and a simultaneous local-model VRAM benchmark remain within 15,872 MiB physical used memory; otherwise OmniVoice remains the truthful default.

Ollama optimization distinguishes weight quantization from KV-cache quantization: q4_K_M weights remain the compact baseline, Flash Attention plus q8_0 KV and single parallel request are preferred, while partial GPU offload is an explicit slower degraded profile rather than a transparent mid-request VRAM spill.

Resource telemetry reports physical GPU totals and provider-attributable current/peak values when available, keeps unsupported per-model values null, and records the all-on measured peak without converting scheduler reservations into fake CUDA measurements.

Future learning uses owner-consented, curated and versioned Vietnamese conversation examples for offline SFT/LoRA and chosen/rejected preference pairs for DPO/ORPO-style training, with frozen evaluation, manual promotion and rollback; raw live chat never updates weights automatically.
allowed_dependencies: Existing Python standard library, PyTorch CUDA stack, Vue 3/TypeScript, Electron typed preload, Ollama local API and repository test tooling.
One reviewed local TTS package/checkpoint may be pinned only if its code, weights and known data terms satisfy the current local non-commercial owner-testing policy and the real benchmark gates.
acceptance_criteria: Reproduction or fault injection shows a resource load/unload click during a short control-plane outage recovers after readiness, while a sustained outage logs one bounded E_DESKTOP_CONTROL_OFFLINE result with model/action context and no unbounded console spam.
A desktop layout regression proves the last long assistant message and composer are both reachable after scrolling at the screenshot viewport size and at a smaller supported height.

At least one credible newer Vietnamese local TTS candidate is verified from primary sources and run on the owner GPU when license/runtime compatibility permits; the default changes only if intelligibility/quality and the all-on admission gate beat OmniVoice without exceeding the ceiling.

The actual launcher/runtime enables or clearly diagnoses Ollama Flash Attention, q8_0 KV cache and one parallel request; documentation states that q8 weight quantization would consume more memory than the installed q4_K_M and that partial offload requires reload plus slower CPU/RAM execution.

A bounded all-on run records physical VRAM peak, resident model list and every attributable per-provider value, preserves unknown where attribution is impossible, then unloads test-only residency and removes generated artifacts.

Documentation gives the owner a concrete M11 data format and staged SFT/LoRA plus preference-learning workflow for improving Hina's Vietnamese conversation quality without unsafe online self-training.
Narrow desktop/control/text/speech/resource tests, one real startup smoke and git diff check pass; GitNexus impact precedes symbol edits and detect_changes validates scope before commit.
